findings.passage: With this regressive bill, House Republicans aren’t fooling anyone or safeguarding election integrity.
findings.note: Statement issued in her name on the day of the House vote on the SAVE Act (H.R. 22). It says the bill's registration requirements and limits on absentee and mail-in voting are voter suppression. It names married women who changed their last name, rural voters and overseas servicemembers as people affected, and calls claims of widespread non-citizen voting a lie.
